workshoptitle: Build Network Experience Intelligence with Oracle AI Database 26ai

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: The Seer Comms network-experience decision journey and workshop goals.

tutorials.title: Getting Started
tutorials.description: Open Database Actions and prepare SQL Worksheet as LLUSER.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Data Foundation
tutorials.description: Inspect the Seer Comms semantic layer and the connected object families behind the application.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Telecom Service Assurance Dashboard
tutorials.description: Trace operational KPIs to subscriber-signal, service, capacity, and service-order evidence.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Subscriber Service Orders
tutorials.description: Use JSON Relational Duality to work with service orders as both documents and relational evidence.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Subscriber Experience Signal Feed
tutorials.description: Use AI Vector Search to find services and subscriber signals by meaning.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Subscriber and Network Impact Graph
tutorials.description: Use Property Graph and SQL/PGQ to investigate the reach of a network-experience case.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Network Access and Field Operations
tutorials.description: Use Oracle Spatial to connect coverage zones, network sites, capacity, and field response.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Predictive Service Assurance
tutorials.description: Use Oracle Machine Learning to score capacity-risk evidence inside the Telco schema.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Conclusion
tutorials.description: Connect the Telco decision journey to a converged database outcome.

tutorials.title: Lab 9: Final Quiz
tutorials.description: Check your understanding of the connected network-experience evidence journey.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving Live Help.
